name: Inventor’s Cabin
storyline:
Inventor's Cabin is a top-down immersive simulation about cars. Blending deep technical mechanics with grand business strategy, your goal is to build the ultimate car company from the ground up.

Your journey begins not in a corporate boardroom, but in a dusty inventor's cabin. Here, every bolt matters. Use your own hands to draft blueprints, machine custom parts, and assemble the vehicle that will change the world. But building the perfect car is just the beginning; selling it to the masses is the true challenge.
summary: Start in a humble cabin with nothing but tools and a vision. In Inventor's Cabin, you are an engineer aiming to conquer the world. Design engines from scratch, build prototypes by hand, and evolve your workshop into a massive automated factory. Create your own car company and dominate the global automotive industry in this immersive top-down simulation.
